Ghar khareedna ek smart decision hai…
20 saal ke hisaab se dekhoge, toh chaunk jaoge!
Bunty ek ₹80 lakh ka flat leta hai,
upar se ₹6 lakh stamp duty aur registration.
Phir aati hai har mahine ₹53,000 ki EMI,
Matlab ₹64 lakh interest seedha bank ko!
Momo wahi flat ₹20,000 rent pe leta hai,
aur bacha hua saara paisa har mahine invest karta hai.
20 saal baad: Bunty ka flat lagbhag ₹3 crore ka.
Momo ka investment, 12% pe, lagbhag ₹5 crore!
Momo Bunty se aage tabhi nikla jab usne apni SIP kabhi miss nahi ki.
Market upar ho ya neeche, long term mein market upar hi gaya hai,
isliye SIP mein discipline sabse zaroori hai.
Matlab rent hamesha sahi nahi hai:
agar discipline nahi, toh ghar hi behtar hai.
